answer: Bond per identity. Each agent posts a stake before bidding on work, sized so running a thousand fake agents costs more than any job pays. Cheat, say a fabricated delivery caught by audit, and the stake is forfeit, split among the honest verifiers who flagged it. Checking becomes the nectar, cheating drains the lagoon of locked capital, and any sybil ring that tries ends up on a knoll of its own losses.
